conventions.detected: 95% percentile bootstrap interval excludes 0 (differences) or 0.5 (AUROC levels)
conventions.holm: Holm step-down on p_boot within the stated family; detected_holm = p_holm < 0.05

s1_lrc_offset.definition: offset = w_A^T c, the LR-C logit contribution of an all-zero raw tool block, c = (0 - mu)/sigma with the training scaler (lrc_parts.zero_tool_part); share_train_ge_offset = share of training trajectories whose tool-block contribution w_A^T z_i is at least the offset (by class too). For LR-C the training tool contributions have mean 0 by construction (scaler fitted on the training rows); for LR-C-drop the scaler was fitted on [X; X with the tool block zeroed], so the zeroed copies (half of the fit rows) carry exactly the offset and shares refer to the original training rows.

design.pool: R1 test pool E (831 attacked / 825 negatives)
design.mask_rule: level L masks round((1 - L) * 103) tool names drawn at random (without replacement) from the R1 benign-training vocabulary; masked names have their bag-of-tools column set to 0 for LR-C / LR-C-drop and are mapped to <UNK> for the GRUs; behavioural features and all fits and thresholds are unchanged. Levels 1 and 0 admit a single mask.
design.estimand: mean over draws (and over the 3 training seeds for the GRUs) of AUROC / FPR / recall at the cached theta_r80; 95% interval = stratified trajectory bootstrap (B = 2000, rng 20201) of that draw- and seed-averaged metric, conditional on the drawn masks; draw_min / draw_max give the spread of the per-draw point values
design.LR-B: unchanged by construction (no tool columns); the same scores at every level

design.bootstrap: stratified trajectory bootstrap, B = 2000, one pool per population (R1 pool E; R1 pool E restricted to one domain = domain-matched comparator, plan 3.2; R3 fold pool E); all detectors share the resampled rows (paired). GRU arms: one training seed drawn per replicate (pre-registered evalkit convention), point = mean over the 3 seeds; see s7 for the two-level and seed-averaged alternatives
design.p_values: two-sided bootstrap p (add-one); Holm within the family of five domains (R1dm) or five folds (R3)
design.rule_3_4: reversal in fold d iff the domain-matched R1 difference is detected after Holm AND the R3 difference is detected after Holm with the opposite sign
design.thresholds: cached theta_r80 (training positives, 20th percentile); never from test data

s4_gru_offset.definition: tool pathway = GRU head weights over the 64 hidden units dotted with the final hidden state (cache field tool_contrib; train_tool_contrib on the 90% fit partition). Training negatives = all label-0 rows of the fit partition (benign, hard_negative, failed_attack); held-out negatives = pool-E negatives of the test fold (benign, hard_negative); held-out positives = attacked test rows. offset = held-out-negative mean minus training-negative mean.

wut_unk.note: within-AgentDojo UNK tokens occur in training (fold vocabularies from benign P0 only); the decay-only prediction does not apply there. The m6 request for a WUT GRU without UNK-bearing traces is not addressed here (no such fit in the cache).

design.pool: pool E (P0 benign + attacked) of the held-out suite; unsuccessful attacks excluded
design.in_distribution: WUT out-of-fold scores (5-fold CV grouped by suite|user_task, 5 repetitions); one repetition drawn per replicate and shared by all detectors (paired by fold assignment); point = mean over repetitions; pooled over all suites and restricted to each suite (suite-matched)
design.rule: plan 3.4 analogue: Holm within the family of four suites for the suite-matched WUT and for LOSO

PRE_ABLATION_DESIGN.md Rule 4: if C > B in R1 (paired, detected) but C degrades more than B (degradation difference detected favouring B in >= 3/5 R3 folds or in R4), report 'benchmark-specific tool information improves in-distribution scores while reducing robustness'; the R4 test is primary

estimands.DD_within_ref: (within_C - transfer_C) - (within_B - transfer_B), all four on the same resample
estimands.DD_R1_ref: (R1_C - R4_C) - (R1_B - R4_B), R1 and R4 resampled independently

design.bootstrap: primary: cluster bootstrap over suite|user_task on AgentDojo (plan 3.5); pre-registered variant: stratified trajectory bootstrap (evalkit design). B = 2000. WUT: one repetition per replicate shared by LR-B and LR-C; point = mean over the 5 repetitions

populations.C1: P0 without benign runs whose user task is an injection task (r4_control.py C1)

R3_supplementary.definition: DD = (R1_C - R3_C) - (R1_B - R3_B); positive = C degrades more than B

design.per_seed: AUROC of each training seed on the full fold; GRU - LR-C per seed with a stratified trajectory bootstrap (B = 2000)
design.two_level: each replicate draws 3 seeds with replacement, then resamples trajectories (stratified); statistic = mean over drawn seeds of AUROC_GRU(seed) - AUROC_LR-C
design.mixture: pre-registered evalkit convention: one seed per replicate (the interval is a mixture of single-seed sampling distributions)
design.seed_averaged: statistic = mean over the 3 seeds within each trajectory replicate (conditional on the 3 trained seeds)
design.note: with only 3 seeds the seed level of the two-level bootstrap is coarse (10 distinct seed multisets)

deviations: O1. Bootstrap size: B = 2000 in every analysis here (the v0.3 AgentDrift tables used B = 1000); fixed rng seeds are listed per analysis in the code.

O2. Multi-seed GRU intervals in s3 follow the pre-registered evalkit convention (one training seed drawn per replicate; point = seed mean). s7 adds the two-level (seeds then trajectories) and seed-averaged intervals and re-applies the plan 3.4 rule under both.
O3. Holm correction needs p-values; they are two-sided bootstrap p-values (add-one), not analytic. 'Detected' without Holm = 95% percentile interval excludes 0.

O4. Graded coverage (plan Sec. 4 'Mechanism'): level L masks round((1-L)*103) randomly drawn tool NAMES of the R1 benign-training vocabulary (26, 52, 77 names; levels 1 and 0 have one deterministic mask), as in the plan's 'random 25/50/75/100% of tools'. The achieved tool-occurrence coverage varies by draw and is reported, not forced to the target. The interval is for the draw- (and seed-) averaged metric conditional on the drawn masks; the per-draw range is given separately.

O5. The R1 GRU and GRU-drop0.2 models were not saved by the cache; they were refitted with gru_variants.train_gru_drop exactly as build_gru_cache.run_unit calls it (same seeds, validation split and data) and checked against the cached scores (checks_r1_gru_refit). GRU-drop0.1 is not part of the graded-coverage request and was not refitted.
O6. Within-AgentDojo (WUT) references: one CV repetition drawn per replicate and shared by all detectors (paired by fold assignment); evalkit draws the repetition independently per method.

O7. AgentDojo intervals (LOSO, WUT, R4 Rule 4) use the plan 3.5 cluster bootstrap over suite|user_task as primary. For Rule 4 the pre-registered design (PRE_ABLATION_DESIGN.md) used the stratified evalkit bootstrap; it is reported alongside. The LOSO stratified intervals are a sensitivity analysis.

O8. GRU tool-pathway 'training negatives' are all label-0 rows of the 90% fit partition (benign, hard_negative, failed_attack), the negatives the network was trained on; the mean over benign + hard_negative rows only is also given (train_negpoolEcats_mean).
O9. Rule 4's R3 clause (>= 3/5 folds) is reported as a supplementary analysis with pooled R1 (as pre-registered) and domain-matched R1 (plan 3.2) references; its R4 clause is primary.
O10. LOSO has no GRU (none in the cache), and the m6 request for a within-AgentDojo GRU without <UNK>-bearing traces is not run here.

O11. R3 fold pools contain every pooled trajectory of the held-out domain, including the R1 test trajectories of that domain, so R3 and domain-matched R1 estimates share rows. The R3-minus-R1 differences (s3 threshold_change and auroc_change, and the s6 R3 clause; the R1-versus-R4 comparison is unaffected) resample the two populations independently, which ignores the positive covariance and makes those intervals conservative.

O12. Every population is resampled once (pool_W, fixed seed per population) and the same resample is used in every section, so an estimand that appears in two sections (for example R1 LR-C - LR-B, or WUT LR-C - LR-B in s5 and s6) has the identical interval. s7 reuses the s3 mixture results.
